answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Nobody is waved through free: 35 stamped dockets, each costing $26 to have checked is the price, and the island never covers it twice. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. A seat is earned, not claimed: Physicbound bone setter pest licence makes sure of that, since a licence bone setters carry after bone room hearings. The wharf is checked, not assumed. The clerk notes zephyr.
